title: Mounting product routes and non-DRF endpoints into root URLs
answers: How are product routes mounted into PostHog's root URL dispatcher?
Where do product-specific non-DRF plain Django URLs need to be registered?
How do product backend routes hook into posthog/urls.py?
body:
Product viewsets and routes are dynamically wired into `posthog/urls.py:urlpatterns` using `posthog/product_urls.py:ProductRootRoutes`.
- DRF ViewSets register on routers via `register_routes(routers)` in `products/<product>/backend/routes.py`.
- Plain Django paths cannot register on DRF routers; products must define them in either `api_urlpatterns` or `webhook_urlpatterns` in `products/<product>/backend/routes.py`.
- `posthog/product_urls.py:ProductRootRoutes` collects `api_urlpatterns` and `webhook_urlpatterns` across all discovered products and mounts them into `posthog/urls.py` under the product root.
applies: When adding API routes or webhook URLs within product apps under products/<product>/backend/.
